objective: Separate Cluster/Organization funds from personal earnings and implement reported direct-to-registered-GCash voluntary contributions with independent scoped reconciliation into the canonical funded Community Ledger.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main a4badb341c16444fa42c44a5e0906760b85d2a08 inspected 2026-11-10; exact production Android binary/runtime not verified. No OTA or production web deployment authorized as part of this change.
chosenApproach: Re-use giving_scope_receivers per exact scope; create private report-only database records and independent finance review, credit canonical Community Fund ledger via unique event-key transaction; mount scope-only fund UI replacing personal wallet in scoped Homes.
selectionRationale: Separate reporting from verified ledger credit avoids false paid status and duplicate/replayed revenue; existing PF project reserve/spend accounting remains the only scope cash ledger. A Giving app deep link alone does not capture manual transfer evidence.
alternativeApproaches: Do not credit unverified manual reports directly to community ledger (unsafe self-minting).
Do not build an independent scope wallet parallel to PF canonical reserves and project approvals (risk of double balances).
acceptanceChecks: Personal wallet appears only on Public Home, with Cluster and Organization fund card instead.
Members can copy active exact-scope GCash receiver and report amount/reference, without automatic credit.
Authorized non-submitting finance manager verifies from independent GCash statement, credits canonical scope ledger once or rejects.
5%/7% tier designation and funded settlement untouched; disabled settlements never count as cash.
Changing scopes invalidates stale cached display; read failures do not masquerade as zero; no OTA publish.
preserveBehaviors: Existing private user earnings/withdrawals and QMP remain unchanged.
Canonical scope Fund request/vote/release ledger remains intact.
Scope registered GCash receiver settings remain exact-scope admin only.
AdMob and financial finalization disabled gates remain unchanged.
Other Cluster and Organization Home modules untouched.
